title: Thanh Van Mon Episode 11: The Butterfly Queen's Decree
audience: Fans of Chinese fantasy, cultivation/xianxia drama viewers, 18-35 demographic who enjoy butterfly symbolism, hidden underground realms, beautiful visual storytelling
tone: Royal command, sorrowful duty, ethereal beauty, sacrifice demanded

concept.hook: The Butterfly Queen looked at her — the last daughter of the bloodline — and made the demand no one expected.
concept.story_arc: Queen reveals the prophecy → The price of staying → Butterfly wings offered but at cost → She must choose home or duty → The decree
concept.emotion: Wonder → Shock → Sorrow → Decision → Accepting decree

shots.prompt: Wide shot — the throne room of the underground butterfly kingdom. Massive crystal columns filled with glowing butterflies. The Butterfly Queen on her jade throne, wings folded — deep blue and silver, ancient and magnificent. Our protagonist stands before her, small beneath the throne. The Queen's voice echoes: 'The prophecy said you would come. It also said — you would have to leave.' Camera: wide shot — grandeur of throne room, queen on high throne, small protagonist below. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Wide — throne room grandeur, queen on high jade throne, small protagonist below, 6s
shots.narration: The Butterfly Queen revealed the truth. The prophecy had two endings — and only one was kind.
shots.sfx: Butterfly wing flutter, queen's echoing voice, crystal chiming, distant humming

shots.prompt: Close-up — the Queen's face: beautiful, ancient, sad. 'To stay here, you must surrender your mortal memories. Your human past — forgotten. You will be reborn as a butterfly spirit. Never remembering who you were.' Our protagonist's face: shock, then grief. The Queen continues: 'Or — you leave. Carry the bloodline forward. But the kingdom will fade without you.' Camera: close-up — queen's sad face, protagonist's shock and grief. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Close-up — queen's sad face explaining the choice, protagonist's grief, 6s
shots.narration: Stay and forget everything. Or leave and watch them all fade away.
shots.sfx: Queen's soft voice, her sharp inhale, distant butterfly chorus, heartbeat

shots.prompt: Close-up — she raises her hand to her chest. Speaks: 'I cannot forget my mother. Her last words to me.' She touches the butterfly mark on her forearm. 'But I cannot let the kingdom die.' She looks up at the Queen. 'There must be another way.' The Queen smiles sadly. Reaches forward. Places a small jade butterfly in her palm. Camera: close-up — her hand on chest, jade butterfly placed in palm, glowing softly. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Close-up — hand on chest, jade butterfly placed in palm, glowing softly, 6s
shots.narration: There was another way. But it demanded everything she had.
shots.sfx: Jade butterfly chiming, her quiet voice, queen's sigh, light glow

shots.prompt: Medium shot — the Queen stands, spreads her wings — massive, luminous blue-silver. 'Bind your bloodline to this jade. Return to the surface. When the kingdom truly needs you — the jade will open the gate again.' The jade butterfly in the protagonist's hand blazes. She kneels. Accepts the decree. Butterfly-winged guards watch silently. Camera: medium — queen standing and spreading wings, protagonist kneeling accepting decree, glowing jade. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Medium — queen spreading wings, protagonist kneeling, glowing jade decree, 6s
shots.narration: The Queen's decree: take the jade. Carry the kingdom's hope. Return when called.
shots.sfx: Wings spreading with whoosh, jade blazing, her kneeling, guards watching in silence

shots.prompt: Wide shot — she walks toward the Red Butterfly Gate at the kingdom's edge. Butterfly-winged residents part for her — bowing. Some cry. A child butterfly spirit reaches out — she touches its tiny wing. Continues walking. At the gate, she looks back one last time at the beautiful kingdom. Tucks the jade butterfly safely in her robes. Steps through the gate. Camera: wide shot — walking through bowing residents, child touching her hand, last look back at the glowing kingdom, stepping through. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Wide — walking through bowing residents, last look at kingdom, stepping through gate, 6s
shots.narration: She left the kingdom she had just found. Carrying its hope like a seed in her heart.
shots.sfx: Footsteps, bowed residents murmuring, child butterfly spirit's wing rustle, gate opening, her slow breath
